sites.note: Filesystem + application-policy boundary; stat()/mime checks. Candidate for an injected filesystem contract, but the helper is called from controllers and views, so the refactor is presentation-only.

Single availability-service lookup inside a 1414-line controller. Safe to convert to constructor injection, but the controller is the largest surface in the app so it is deferred to the controller-splitting phase.
clearPermissionCache() is a static-context call from the middleware invalidate path. Low risk; mechanical to inject.

HIGHEST RISK. These resolve services from inside Eloquent model events, so they execute inside whatever transaction the caller opened. Loyalty and referral side effects are therefore transaction-timing dependent. Any change alters financial/loyalty behaviour.
Resolves RolePermissionChecker to answer hasPermission(). The Model->Http edge was already removed in Phase 0.13; the remaining locator is a narrow, cache-backed, side-effect-free lookup.
Finance, audit and commission services are resolved mid-flow across multi-channel manual booking paths. Financial.
Resolves BookingService from inside revenue-split resolution. Financial.

not_a_violation.App/Services/Pricing/ScreenPricingResolv: Its own public method resolve(Screen) plus $this->resolve() are an ordinary method declaration and call, not a container lookup. An early draft detector misreported this; fixed by scanning backwards for the previous significant token.

enforcement: The exact 9-file set is pinned in ArchitectureRuleTest::test_service_locator_debt_does_not_grow. A new locator fails the suite; a removed one must be reflected in the same commit.
